messages:
elena: FYI flagged a 1.8k embed spike on INV-20245 for customer NovaSearch. Numbers look like duplicates from a vendor aggregator retry loop. Putting this here for visibility and approval for provisional credit. @ryan @tomas

ryan: Can you share the invoice window and a couple of sample request_ids? Also which vendor aggregator?

elena: Window = 2026-02-14T12:00:00Z..2026-02-14T14:00:00Z. Vendor=edge-agg-us-east (third-party proxy). Sample IDs in thread below. Billing bot alerted as well.

billing-bot: NOTICE: meter_anomaly | customer=novasearch-88 | window=2026-02-14T12:00:00Z..2026-02-14T14:00:00Z | embed_delta=1796 | confidence=0.92

tomas: I ran a quick dedupe fingerprint on a 50-row sample. Lots of identical payload_hash + incremental region_hops. Suggests aggregator retransmitted on failover rather than de-duplicating. Query used:
```sql
SELECT request_id, payload_hash, aggregator_node, timestamp
FROM embeds.ingest_raw
WHERE customer_id='novasearch-88' AND timestamp >= '2026-02-14T12:00:00Z' AND timestamp <= '2026-02-14T14:00:00Z'
ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 200;
```

ryan: If it's the aggregator, we should mark the duplicates non-billable and ask vendor for root cause. Ops can run a targeted backfill to change billing_flag=false for deduped rows. Estimate 1-3 hours.

elena: Estimated credit = 1796 * $0.18 = $323.28. Recommend provisional credit rounded to $325 while we reconcile. Need finance sign-off to apply on INV-20245.

clare-cs: CS wants us to apply provisional credit ASAP and let the customer know. They're getting nervous. Can we communicate a timeline?

ryan: Ops starts backfill in ~10m. I'll post job id and ETA. After backfill, we'll run a reconciliation diff and produce a one-page reconciliation report for finance and CS.

billing-bot: ACTION: create_provisional_credit | invoice=INV-20245 | amt=325.00 | reason="aggregator duplicate retransmits" | status=pending_approval

elena: Maria in finance isn't on this thread; Ryan please tag @maria in the billing_journal entry. I'm approving provisional credit request to avoid escalation, pending the reconciled report.

tomas: Backfill job started: job-ops-7783. Will update on completion. Also opening vendor ticket with edge-agg team: VND-5342.

ryan: Backfill succeeded. job-ops-7783 finished at 2026-02-14T12:47:20Z. Reconciled delta = 0 after dedupe (1796 removed). Attaching summary to invoice in billing system.

clare-cs: Thanks — I'll let the customer know provisional credit applied and we'll follow up with the vendor RCA. :pray:
